alarms.name: notifications-in-dead-letter-queue
alarms.description: A job notification could not be processed after every redelivery. The referenced job is not lost, but nothing will pick it up until an operator republishes or fails it by policy.

alarms.name: notification-backlog-aging
alarms.description: Notifications are waiting longer than a worker should take to claim them, which means worker capacity or claiming is impaired.

alarms.name: outbox-publication-stalled
alarms.description: An authoritative transition committed but its notification has not reached the queue, so the work it schedules is not moving.

alarms.name: attempts-losing-their-lease
alarms.description: Workers are being fenced for lease expiry. One is ordinary recovery; a sustained rate means workers are dying or too slow to heartbeat.

alarms.name: jobs-exhausting-their-retries
alarms.description: A job reached terminal failure after every allowed attempt. Tenant work was lost to a fault the retry policy could not absorb.

alarms.name: reconciler-failing
alarms.description: The reconciler could not complete a pass, so expired leases, retry delays, and stranded jobs are no longer being repaired.

alarms.name: artifact-commits-refused
alarms.description: Stored bytes did not match what an attempt declared. No job succeeded on a wrong artifact, but the object store or a worker is misbehaving.

alarms.name: diff-queue-latency-high
alarms.description: Analyses are waiting too long between request and claim for the deployment's stated responsiveness.

alarms.name: worker-jobs-failing
alarms.description: Workers are reporting failed attempts for tenant analyses rather than committing results.

alarms.name: public-api-returning-server-errors
alarms.description: The public API is answering tenant requests with server errors.

alarms.name: control-plane-targets-unhealthy
alarms.description: No healthy control-plane target is behind the public listener.

alarms.name: worker-service-below-capacity
alarms.description: Fewer worker tasks are running than the service asks for, so claims will slow or stop.

alarms.name: database-storage-low
alarms.description: Authoritative state is close to running out of storage.

alarms.name: database-cpu-saturated
alarms.description: The database that arbitrates every lifecycle transition is saturated.
